description: Actual later Action moves one-inch sphere20east+10north through a2inch aperture, with bend outside the wall slab. Independent paid PFS on an ordinary visible person does not block this Universal sight. Later Search is another real Action, not creation/movement bonus.

originalScenarioCompleteUnchanged.originalTextUnchanged: TU4-12-A: After creation, the caster spends an Action to move the eye thirty feet along an open corridor and around a corner through a two-inch gap. It sees only what ordinary local lighting reveals from the new point. The caster receives no sound and cannot cast from the eye’s position.
